 Order
Learned GA informs that notice has duly been served upon the prosecutrix.

This is the first application filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 relating to FIR No. 431/2022 registered at P.S - Chainpur,
District- Khargone (M.P.) for the offence under sections 363, 366, 368, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and sections 3 / 4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

2/ As per prosecution story, on 22/11/2022 father of the prosecutrix / complainant lodged missing person report at police station Shantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7015685/
1 - Chainpur, District - Khargone stating that his minor daughter / prosecutrix is missing from home since last night.
He searched for her everywhere, but could not find her.

During investigation, it was gathered that present applicant abducted the prosecutrix and took her with him at different places,
where he repeatedly committed rape upon her.
Accordingly, the aforementioned offence has been registered against the applicant.
3/ Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this offence.
Applicant is in custody since 03/12/2022.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.

Prosecutrix (PW-1) and her parents (PW-2) and (PW-3) have been examined before the trial Court and they have turned hostile and did not state anything against the applicant in respect of the aforementioned offence.
Co-accused Champabai has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 23/01/2023 passed in MCRC no. 1866/2023.
Final conclusion of trial shall take sufficient long time.
Hence, he prays that the applicant be enlarged on bail.
4/ Per-contra, learned PL for respondent - State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
5/ Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case dairy.

6/ Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by both the parties,
nature of allegation as also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trial Court and she has turned hostile; she categorically stated in her statement that present applicant neither abducted, nor committed rape upon her; her parents have also turned hostile and deposed in the same manner in view of the evidence available on record, I deem it proper to release the accused / applicants on bail.
7/ Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.
75,000/- (Rs. Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.
8/ He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C., Certified copy, as per Rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE amol Shantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7015685/
